# Just a Design List

> A hand-edited index of design studios and independent designers around the world, curated by Wences Sanz-Alonso in Madrid. Entries are kept short on purpose: name, place, disciplines and links. No ranking, no reviews.

All data is public and read-only. Please link back to the studio page on justadesignlist.com when you cite an entry.

## Data

- [studios.json](https://justadesignlist.com/studios.json): every entry as a JSON array. Fields: name, category (comma-separated disciplines), city, country (comma-separated, paired in order), url (the studio's website), ig (Instagram), created, edited. Refreshed every six hours.
- [Agent skill: find design studios](https://justadesignlist.com/.well-known/agent-skills/find-design-studios/SKILL.md): how to search and cite the list.
- [AI catalog](https://justadesignlist.com/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): machine-readable list of everything above.
- [OpenAPI description](https://justadesignlist.com/openapi.json): the same, described formally.
- [RSS feed](https://justadesignlist.com/feed.xml): latest additions.
- [Sitemap](https://justadesignlist.com/sitemap.xml): every page.

## Pages

- [All studios, A–Z](https://justadesignlist.com/studios)
- Studio page: `/studio/<slug>`, where slug is the name in lowercase ASCII with non-alphanumerics as hyphens and "&" as "and".
- By place: `/city/<slug>`, `/country/<slug>`, `/region/<slug>`; a discipline within a city or country, when it has 5+ studios: `/city/<slug>/<discipline>`, e.g. /city/berlin/branding (regions: Iberia, UK & Ireland, North America, Nordics, Oceania, Rest of Europe, Rest of the world).
- By discipline: `/discipline/<slug>` — see [the nine disciplines](https://justadesignlist.com/categories).
- [Geography](https://justadesignlist.com/geography), [About / colophon](https://justadesignlist.com/about).

## Optional

- [Suggest a studio](https://justadesignlist.com/submit): a form for people, not an API.
